records.package: LQFP-48 candidate from KiCad symbol; verify official ST package table and drawing
layout_notes: Verify LQFP48 pinout, crystal pins, USB pins, CAN pins, BOOT0, SWD, and analog pins before use.
power_notes: Verify all VDD/VSS/VDDA/VSSA/VBAT pins and decoupling from datasheet.
communication_notes: USB FS and CAN family capabilities exist; exact pin mux and bootloader support require source verification.
common_mistakes: Using Blue Pill pin labels as MCU pinout.
Assuming clone-board USB, crystal, regulator, and boot circuits are correct.
ai_warnings: Do not use this record for final schematic or PCB work until pinout and footprint are verified.
suitable_use_cases: Legacy STM32F1 planning and review after lifecycle/package verification.
not_suitable_use_cases: New designs that need current low-power/security features without lifecycle review.
reference_circuits: Blue Pill schematic only after exact source verification
notes: Candidate local KiCad symbol and footprint found by read-only search.

records.package: LQFP-64 candidate from KiCad symbol; verify official ST package table and drawing

not_suitable_use_cases: Low-power security-focused designs where U5/H5 may be better.

records.package: TSSOP-20 candidate from KiCad symbol; verify official ST package table and drawing
layout_notes: Low pin count requires careful SWD, boot, oscillator, and UART allocation.
power_notes: Verify VDD/VSS/VDDA/VSSA pins and decoupling despite small package.

Assuming F1/F4 BOOT0 behavior.

records.package: LQFP-48 candidate from KiCad symbol; verify official ST package table and drawing
layout_notes: Mixed-signal, USB, UCPD, FDCAN, and analog reference layout require careful review.
communication_notes: FDCAN requires external CAN FD transceiver; USB needs connector/clock/ESD review.
common_mistakes: Connecting FDCAN pins directly to a connector.
Ignoring analog reference pins.
Using NUCLEO-G431RB package assumptions.
ai_warnings: Do not claim CAN FD support without transceiver and timing review.
suitable_use_cases: Motor control, power conversion, mixed-signal, and FDCAN planning after verification.
required_external_parts: CAN FD transceiver if FDCAN used
USB support parts if USB used
reference_circuits: NUCLEO-G431RB reference only after schematic extraction
notes: Two KiCad symbols exist; choose only after package/order-code review.

records.package: LQFP-100 candidate from KiCad symbol; verify official ST package table and drawing
layout_notes: High-speed clocks, USB, Ethernet, FDCAN, external memory, caches, and power domains require deep review.
power_notes: Verify VCAP/regulator mode, all VDD/VSS domains, VDDA/VSSA/VREF+, VBAT, and USB supplies.
communication_notes: FDCAN and USB capabilities exist in product line; exact package pins and PHY mode require verification.
common_mistakes: Using simple F4 minimum circuit on H7.
Missing VCAP/regulator requirements.
Ignoring cache/external-memory implications.
ai_warnings: Do not route H7 high-speed interfaces without stackup and impedance planning.
suitable_use_cases: High-performance control and connectivity after architecture review.
not_suitable_use_cases: Simple low-cost boards where G0/F0/F1 would reduce risk.
reference_circuits: NUCLEO-H743ZI historical reference only; check current replacement boards
notes: NUCLEO-H743ZI official page observed obsolete/out of production.
